incident-bot: PagerDuty incident page fired: PD-78921 - inference-queue-high-5xx — priority: P1
pagerduty: Page triggered for service: inference-requests-prod (strategy: seqlimit) — link: https://pd.example/INCIDENT/PD-78921
alice.nguyen: acked and taking ownership — jumping on bridge now :headphones:
sam.kelly: I'm on standby, can assist with autoscaler checks
carla: I'm seeing a quick spike in 5xx from eu-west-2 region, not global yet
alice.nguyen: noted. initial triage: response_code=502 from router, burst at 16:03:12 -> 16:05:50
alice.nguyen: running quick query: `SELECT count(*) FROM logs WHERE service='router' AND status=502 AND ts > now()-5m;`
carla: paste: results ~2.4k 502s, ~80% from model-pool-3
dave_ops: I'm scaling up pool 3 now, `rbacctl scale model-pool-3 3` — will take ~60s
erin_sre: i've opened an autoscale incident, checking metrics for queue depth and gpu-util
alice.nguyen: rolling fallback to model-variant-small on policy: `fallback: model-variant-small` — issuing rollout
pagerduty: Alert update: ack by alice.nguyen at 16:06 — responders: alice.nguyen, sam.kelly
sam.kelly: confirmed fallback applied, observing drop in 502s, pushing status to bridge
alice.nguyen: customer-impact: a handful of realtime customers reported errors (~12 tenants), most requests retried automatically; surface-level SLO hit for 3m window
carla: stack traces show upstream timeout at 120s to model-pool-3 backends — bfd
dave_ops: scale completed, pool3 nodes healthy, but warmed caches cold — expecting latency spike to persist for ~2m
alice.nguyen: temp mitigation: 1) scaled pool 3 2) applied fallback 3) increased router timeout to 160s for be tolerant
erin_sre: monitoring: queue depth trending down, 99p latency improving, setting alert suppression for 10m to avoid duplicate paging
sam.kelly: I'm going to take over primary ownership for postmortem, alice i'll hand off once stable
alice.nguyen: +1 handoff, going to handback to runbook ops; leaving notes in incident ticket PD-78921
incident-bot: Bridge created: https://meet.example/bridge/PD-78921 — duration so far 28m
alice.nguyen: final check: customers reprocessed, SLO impact limited to 3 minutes, no data loss reported. marking incident in 'stabilized'
sam.kelly: taking over for follow-up actions and postmortem, will ping owner list in 30m for RCA
erin_sre: recommend follow-ups: improve autoscale policy for pool3, add caching warmup step on scale-up
carla: +1, will attach logs and heatmap to the ticket
alice.nguyen: thanks all, reassigning PD incident to sam.kelly per runbook — handing off
sam.kelly: acknowledged handoff, will file RCA and depend on eng-runtime for kernel selection checks
incident-bot: Incident PD-78921 status updated: stabilized -> monitoring; assignee: sam.kelly
alice.nguyen: logging off from bridge, leaving final note: `mitigation: scale + fallback + timeout` — see PD ticket
sam.kelly: will post RCA draft by EOD and checklist for better suppression rules :memo:
carla: thanks team :partyparrot:
